releaseNotes:
• In-App User Activity & Analytics Telemetry: Real-time non-blocking activity tracking (screens, tournaments, wallet, profile, app foreground) with 30-day automatic rolling retention
• High Space-Efficiency: Sub-millisecond indexed activity queries with MongoDB TTL auto-pruning
• In-App Seamless Updater: Sub-2MB binary delta updates via rw_delta for lightning-fast upgrades
